rules.name: Diplomat
rules.desc: Diplomats weave peace in a galaxy of shattered trust. They read tiny expressions, broker treaties, and know when to flatter and when to threaten. Charm is their armor. Words are their weapons.

hopeFeature.name: The Power of Suggestion (3 Hope)
hopeFeature.text: Spend 3 Hope: Plant an Idea (ally's next Presence/Knowledge/Finesse roll has Advantage), Create an Opening (ally's next attack or stealth roll has Advantage), or Gather Intelligence (Keeper gives you one secret Clue about the scene).

classFeature.name: Cultural Lens
classFeature.text: Advantage on all Social tests. Succeed on Persuasion or Deception to gain 1 Favor Token (max 4). Gain 1 Favor Token each long rest.

rules.bgQuestion: What secret compelled you to trust words over weapons?

rules.name: Engineer
rules.desc: Engineers thrive in chaos. Whether hacking rogue AIs or grafting cybernetics onto wounded crewmates, their genius turns duct tape and guts into miracles — just long enough.

hopeFeature.name: Scrap Genius (3 Hope)
hopeFeature.text: Spend 3 Hope to create one functional improvised device from available materials. It works perfectly for one scene, then breaks. The Keeper cannot declare it fails during that scene.

classFeature.name: Field Engineering
classFeature.text: Once per short rest, repair any technology without tools using what's on hand. Mark 1 Stress; the repair holds for the scene. Advantage on rolls to sabotage or interface with technology.

rules.bgQuestion: What machine do you carry guilt for building — or for failing to build?

rules.name: Explorer
items: Encrypted Star Chart (1 free Intel Token per exploration)
rules.desc: Explorers are the eyes and ears of post-Silence civilization, pushing boundaries of what is known and turning whispers of legend into tangible truths.

hopeFeature.name: Pathfinder's Insight (3 Hope)
hopeFeature.text: When making a Travel or Scan roll during a Void Crawl, spend 3 Hope to automatically find a safe route. You also discover one piece of hidden information about the destination.

classFeature.name: Terrain Mastery
classFeature.text: You cannot be surprised in wilderness or unexplored environments. Advantage on all rolls to track, navigate, or survive in the field. Once per long rest, identify any substance, creature, or phenomenon you can observe.

rules.bgQuestion: What is the one place you have not gone back to — and why haven't you?

rules.name: Mystic
rules.desc: Mystics walk through realities where physics crumbles. Caution defines them — one wrong step in the Veil might unravel their mind. They feel the room's substrate shift before anyone else.

hopeFeature.name: Reality Unfold (3 Hope)
hopeFeature.text: Spend 3 Hope to briefly pierce the substrate: ask the Keeper one question about the true nature of a person, object, or location in the scene. The Keeper answers with the deepest truth accessible.

classFeature.name: Veil Alignment (Lux or Void)
classFeature.text: Choose at creation. Lux Mystics gain Advantage on rolls involving light, clarity, revelation, healing substrate. Void Mystics gain Advantage on rolls involving shadow, entropy, erasure, substrate disruption.

rules.bgQuestion: What have you perceived in the Veil that you cannot tell anyone?

sleepingRules.name: Sleeping Mystic
sleepingRules.desc: A ritualist and occult scholar who cannot perceive the Veil, but reconstructs procedures that force it to answer. Their Archive can eventually contain paths from every Domain.

effortFeature.name: The Reading (2 Effort)
effortFeature.text: Study a person, place, object, active Power, or Veil phenomenon. Ask one question about its Veil exposure, Domain signature, history, instability, likely behavior, or required procedure. The Keeper answers truthfully from the available evidence.

classFeature.name: Uncanny Archive
classFeature.text: Begin with every Level 1 Power from two chosen Domains. Research a Domain level with a 4 + level clock. To research Level N, first unlock at least two different Domains at Level N-1. The researched Domain need not continue either prerequisite Domain.

effects.name: Group Calibration
effects.effect: All targets gain +1 to rolls with one chosen Trait.

effects.name: Group Adaptation
effects.effect: All targets gain Advantage against one specific environmental hazard.

effects.name: Sustained Restoration
effects.effect: All targets clear 1 HP after each complete hour; all remaining duration may be consumed to stabilize one affected Dying creature.

resolveMoves.name: Uncanny Power
resolveMoves.access: sum Effort Dice + Knowledge once, capped by character level
resolveMoves.timing: full Action; no Reaction or Passive Powers
resolveMoves.critical: regain all Resolve spent on this invocation; Fear and non-Resolve costs remain

foundation.name: Layered Working
foundation.desc: Choose two different Calibrated Minor Ritual effects instead of one; every target receives both.

specialization.name: Enduring Formula
specialization.desc: Double ritual duration and unlock Protective Geometry: +1 Evasion or +1 to all damage thresholds for the whole group.

mastery.name: Shared Lattice
mastery.desc: Double numerical ritual benefits; Group Adaptation protects against two hazards; all affected creatures gain group telepathy for the duration.

foundation.name: Perfect Invocation
foundation.desc: Once per Short Rest, manifest one known Power at or below your level with no Resolve, access roll, or Spellcast Roll. Keeper gains 1 Fear. Retain non-Hope costs and restrictions.

specialization.name: Reach Beyond
specialization.desc: Once per session, attempt an unknown Power exactly one level above you from a Domain you have studied. Keeper gains 1 Fear; roll Knowledge against DC 10 + level. The Power is not learned.

mastery.name: Impossible Efficiency
mastery.desc: Once per session, each Resolve spent on Uncanny Power contributes two Effort Dice instead of one; Fear is based on Resolve actually spent.

foundation.name: Persistent Inquiry
foundation.desc: Advance one Domain Study Project by 1 segment during every Long Rest without consuming a Long Rest move.

specialization.name: Pattern Recognition
specialization.desc: Reduce a new Domain Study clock by the Spellcast Trait modifier, minimum 2 segments.

mastery.name: Parallel Reconstruction
mastery.desc: Research two Domain Paths simultaneously and apply each progress gain to both. Parallel projects do not receive Pattern Recognition's clock reduction.

rules.name: Pilot
rules.desc: Pilots are not just button-pushers. They dance with stardust. Whether chasing Void routes or outmaneuvering pirates, they blend gut instinct with sharp reflexes.

hopeFeature.name: Veil Surge (3 Hope)
hopeFeature.text: Spend 3 Hope to gain Advantage on all ship maneuver rolls for the next hour. During this time, your ship cannot be targeted by standard weapon locks — only specialized systems can track you.

classFeature.name: Neural Interface
classFeature.text: Pilot any vehicle or vessel without penalty, regardless of make or origin. Once per session, declare you know a hidden route — a shortcut, a smuggler's lane — that no one else knows.

rules.bgQuestion: What ship did you lose, and how do you carry that loss?

rules.name: Scholar
rules.desc: Scholars are the crew's lens onto everything the Pearl Era did not preserve. Where others see anomalies, they see breakthroughs. Knowledge is oxygen in the post-Silence galaxy.

hopeFeature.name: Eureka Moment (3 Hope)
hopeFeature.text: Spend 3 Hope to automatically succeed on one research or analysis test. You also uncover a hidden connection — the Keeper provides one piece of unexpected information that reframes the situation.

classFeature.name: Academic Edge
classFeature.text: Once per scene, when you succeed on a Knowledge roll, ask the Keeper one additional question about the subject. Advantage on all rolls to recall historical, scientific, or cultural information.

rules.bgQuestion: What piece of knowledge are you looking for — and what will you do when you find it?

rules.name: Scoundrel
rules.desc: Scoundrels are the rats in the walls — always listening, stealing, surviving. Charm is their lockpick. Paranoia is their armor. The crew's professional liars.

hopeFeature.name: Vanishing Act (3 Hope)
hopeFeature.text: Spend 3 Hope to disappear from sight and sound for 1 minute. Immune to all tracking (visual, audio, thermal, network, psionic). Reappear wherever you choose within the scene.

classFeature.name: Shadow Step
classFeature.text: Once per encounter, move through difficult terrain or past an obstacle without a roll. Advantage on all rolls to pick locks, bypass security, or blend into crowds.

rules.bgQuestion: Who are you running from — and do they know you're running?

rules.name: Soldier
rules.desc: A Soldier's expertise is not just in fighting — it is in reading threats before they strike, turning a panicked crowd into a disciplined unit, knowing when to break bones to save lives.

hopeFeature.name: Combat Surge (2 Hope)
hopeFeature.text: After you hit with an attack, spend 2 Hope to immediately make a second attack against the same or a different target. You may also move up to Close range as part of this action.

classFeature.name: Tactical Presence
classFeature.text: Allies within Close range gain +1 to attack rolls. Once per encounter, issue a tactical command as a free action: the chosen ally may immediately take a move action out of turn.

rules.bgQuestion: What order did you follow — or refuse to follow — that you still think about?

sleepingRules.name: Sleeping Soldier
sleepingRules.desc: A trained veteran who turns doctrine, repetition, and battlefield procedure into reliable action without cosmic aid.

effortFeature.name: The Held Line (1 Effort)
effortFeature.text: Spend 1 Effort after you successfully hit with an attack to deal an additional 1d6 damage.

classFeature.name: The Drill
classFeature.text: You know all four Common Drills. Your subclass adds one known Drill at Foundation, Specialization, and Mastery. At the beginning of each session, prepare four Drills. Prepared Action and Reaction Drills can each be used once per scene; prepared Passive Drills are always active and do not track uses.

knownCommon.name: Covering Fire
knownCommon.desc: Choose one ally within Close range and one visible enemy within Far range. The ally immediately moves one range band toward cover. Until the movement ends, the Keeper cannot spend Fear to take the Spotlight to attack that ally. This Drill deals no damage.

knownCommon.name: Breach and Clear
knownCommon.desc: Open an ordinary door, hatch, window, or light barrier within Very Close range, then move through it. One willing ally within Very Close range may follow. You both gain Advantage on your next attack or Instinct Roll before your next Spotlight. A reinforced or secured barrier requires a Strength or Finesse Roll.

knownCommon.name: Controlled Withdrawal
knownCommon.desc: Choose one willing ally within Close range. You and that ally immediately move one range band away from the current threat. The ally does not use their Spotlight for this movement.

knownCommon.name: Weapon Transition
knownCommon.desc: Switching to another equipped weapon does not use your Action. If your current action has not resolved, you may complete it with the new weapon.

foundation.name: Bodyguard
foundation.desc: When an ally within Close range would take damage, you may step into the path. Take half the damage yourself; the ally takes none.

specialization.name: Hold Position
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Effort. Designate a position: a doorway, a corridor, or a wounded ally. Until you choose otherwise or you fall, no enemy may pass that position without succeeding on a Strength contest against you.

mastery.name: The Wall
mastery.desc: Allies who fight within Close range of you have Advantage on resistance rolls and clear 1 Stress per scene. Your presence steadies people; this is observable training, not a cosmic effect.

foundation.name: Planted Stance
foundation.desc: When an effect would make you Prone or move you against your will, ignore that effect.

specialization.name: Casualty Extraction
specialization.desc: Choose one willing, Incapacitated, or Dying ally within Close range. Move to them, then move one range band with them. Until the movement ends, if the Keeper spends Fear to take the Spotlight and attack either of you, that attack has Disadvantage. This Drill does not heal, stabilize, or clear conditions.

mastery.name: Anchor the Line
mastery.desc: When an effect would make you or allies within Close range become Prone or move against their will, you and all affected allies within Close range ignore both effects.

foundation.name: Rally
foundation.desc: Once per scene, allies within Close range each clear 1 Stress. You give an order; they remember why they are here.

specialization.name: Coordinated Strike
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Effort. You and one ally each take an action outside the ally's Spotlight. Both actions gain Advantage if they target the same enemy.

mastery.name: One Way Out
mastery.desc: Once per story arc, your voice organizes a group of non-combatant NPCs into coordinated action: an evacuation, a mutiny, or a work stoppage. They move as one while your voice holds.

foundation.name: Tactical Reposition
foundation.desc: Choose up to two willing allies within Close range who can see or hear you. Each immediately moves one range band. This movement does not use their Spotlight.

specialization.name: Suppression Order
specialization.desc: Choose one visible enemy within Far range. Its next attack before your next Spotlight has Disadvantage.

mastery.name: Establish Fire Lane
mastery.desc: Designate a doorway, corridor, bridge, or clear line within Far range. Until your next Spotlight, each enemy crossing it becomes Vulnerable until the end of its next Spotlight.

foundation.name: Show of Force
foundation.desc: Display, without using, your weapon and authority. Hostile NPCs not specifically committed to violence retreat or stand down.

specialization.name: The Disarmament
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Effort during a tense scene. One armed NPC is convinced, through your demeanor, reputation, position, or all three, to lower their weapon for the duration of the scene. The standdown is real; betraying it has reputational cost.

mastery.name: The Cease-Fire
mastery.desc: Once per story arc, between two willing parties, you broker a cease-fire that the involved factions honor. The cease-fire's terms are negotiable; its existence is binding while you live.

foundation.name: Safe Restraint
foundation.desc: After succeeding on a Melee attack, you may deal no damage and apply Restrained instead, provided the target can be physically restrained.

specialization.name: Controlled Disarm
specialization.desc: After succeeding on a Melee attack against a target holding a weapon, you may deal no damage and force it to drop one held weapon within Very Close range. Integrated or body-mounted weapons cannot be affected.

mastery.name: Evacuation Corridor
mastery.desc: Choose up to three willing non-combatants, or one Incapacitated or Dying ally, within Close range. They immediately move one range band toward an exit or cover. During this movement, selected characters have Advantage on rolls to cross, avoid, or resist hazardous terrain and environmental dangers, and any attack the Keeper makes against a selected character after spending Fear to take the Spotlight has Disadvantage. You may move with them, but you do not gain these benefits. This Drill does not remove hazards, heal, or stabilize.

resolveMoves.name: Take the Hit
resolveMoves.text: When an ally within Close range is hit, intercept the attack. Reduce the damage by the rolled total and take any remaining damage yourself.

resolveMoves.name: Disciplined Strike
resolveMoves.text: Add the rolled total to a damage roll. The target cannot spend Armor Slots against the added portion of this damage.

rules.name: Vanguard
rules.desc: Vanguards use their minds to anticipate movements, augment kinetic reflexes, and project will onto the battlefield. The crew's centered presence whose stillness in a crisis steadies everyone.

hopeFeature.name: Path to Nirvana (3 Hope)
hopeFeature.text: Spend 3 Hope to project a psychic burst: all enemies within Close range must succeed on an Instinct check (DC = your Presence + 10) or be briefly stunned — no actions on their next turn.

classFeature.name: Mind Over Matter
classFeature.text: Once per scene, reduce incoming damage to you by your Presence modifier (min 1) through force of will. Advantage on rolls to resist mental influence, fear, and substrate-based attacks.

rules.bgQuestion: What moment taught you that the mind could do what the body could not?

sleepingRules.name: Sleeping Vanguard
sleepingRules.desc: A Refused practitioner who deliberately closes themselves to the substrate and replaces cosmic aid with rehearsed physical and mental discipline.

effortFeature.name: The Refused Path (2 Effort)
effortFeature.text: Spend 2 Effort to enter the Disciplined State for rounds equal to Proficiency + Spellcast Trait modifier. Choose Agility, Instinct, or Strength: gain Advantage with that Trait and add its modifier to Melee and unarmed damage. You are immune to Stunned and Dazed. Your first Melee attack deals +2d6 branch damage. After the first Melee attack against you each round, subsequent Melee attacks have Disadvantage while at least two enemies are within Melee range.

classFeature.name: Trained Body & Unbroken Focus
classFeature.text: Choose Strength or Agility for unarmed strikes. They deal d6 physical damage, increasing to d8 at Level 5 and d10 at Level 8. Without Heavy or Very Heavy armor, gain +1 Evasion. Once per scene, spend 1 Effort when you would mark Stress to prevent it without using your Action. The Refusal is a once-per-scene Reaction costing 1 Effort against eligible Domain Power or Veil rolls.

foundation.name: The Quiet Strike
foundation.desc: Once per scene, when you make a Melee attack while Hidden, the attack ignores 1 Armor Slot.

specialization.name: The Folded Step
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Effort. Move to available cover within Close range and become Hidden. This is not phasing; you have rehearsed this movement for years.

mastery.name: The Folded Exit
mastery.desc: Once per scene, after a successful Melee attack, move from Very Close to Close range toward available cover. Until your next Spotlight, attacks against you have Disadvantage.

foundation.name: Body Memory
foundation.desc: Choose one kind of physical feat you have drilled to mastery, such as a specific climb, throw, or landing. You perform that feat without rolling in routine conditions only: no active opposition, no time pressure, and no real risk. When the feat is contested, rushed, or dangerous, roll normally.

specialization.name: The Channeled Blow
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Effort. Your next Melee attack deals an additional 1d8 Kinetic damage. On a success, move the target one range band directly away from you.

mastery.name: The Settled Ground
mastery.desc: Once per scene, after a successful Melee attack, apply Dazed to the target.

foundation.name: The Cleared Room
foundation.desc: Spend 1 Effort. For the next minute, you and allies within Close range have Advantage on rolls made to resist or clear Frightened, Confused, and Veil-induced deception.

specialization.name: The Held Truth
specialization.desc: Spend 1 Effort during a social or interrogation scene. NPCs who knowingly lie to you mark 1 Stress. NPCs who tell you a painful truth clear 1 Stress. Your presence does this without your speaking.

mastery.name: The Cleared Path
mastery.desc: While you remain at a location affected by deception, illusion, or Veil-induced confusion, you and allies within Close range have Advantage on rolls made against those effects.

resolveMoves.name: The Weightless Art
resolveMoves.text: For the rolled total in rounds, walls, water, cables, and other surfaces can serve as your floor; you fall without sound or harm, and your leaps cross one additional range band. This is motion, never flight.

resolveMoves.name: Falling Star
resolveMoves.text: Close one range band and attack, adding the rolled total to damage. If you arrived from above, use your branch damage type and treat Major and Severe Thresholds as 4 lower for this hit. This penetration replaces and never stacks with the damage type's own.
